headline: A 1999 executive order changed federal civil service rules for government workers and job seekers with psychiatric disabilities.
what_it_does: This order amends the Civil Service Rules, which govern how the federal government hires and manages its civilian workers. The changes deal specifically with people who have psychiatric disabilities. No summary was provided, so the exact details of the rule changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The civil service rules that apply to them were changed by this order.

who_it_affects.group: People with psychiatric disabilities seeking federal jobs
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by changed rules on how the federal government treats applicants with these disabilities.
They must follow the amended civil service rules for workers with psychiatric disabilities.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated; executive orders like this usually take effect when signed, on June 4, 1999.
